diagnostic_identity.form: 8-char lowercase FNV-1a hex of the canonical control identity
diagnostic_identity.purpose: stable opaque projection for telemetry, runtime events, host projections

boundary_enforcement.mechanism: RecoveryTracker private controlKeyToDiagnostic / controlFamilyToDiagnostic Maps + unconditional projection via controlKeyToDiagnosticId / controlFamilyToDiagnosticId
boundary_enforcement.projection_point: RecoveryTracker.snapshot(), RecoveryTracker.getBlockedFamilies(), RecoveryTracker.notifyWith(), recordBlockedAttemptControl() return value, recordToolSuccess() return value
boundary_enforcement.rule: Every emitted identifier is projected to 8-char FNV-1a hex. The legacy *Control methods are private so the runtime cannot bypass the typed identity contract from outside the package.

details: 5 production files moved from sdk/packages/core/src/runtime/recovery/ → sdk/packages/agents/src/runtime/recovery/

RecoveryTracker gained typed-identity overloads that populate projection maps; snapshot/event surfaces automatically project raw canonical labels to diagnostic IDs
Legacy string overloads retained and unchanged (54 C1.0 tests pass without modification)
Recovery module deleted from @cline/core; zero external consumers affected

Production-shaped privacy test (recovery-privacy.test.ts, 5 tests): drives warning → interception → circuit_open through typed-identity API, asserts every exposed field contains only 8-char hex and no canonical input

Snapshot/event projection is unconditional — every emitted identifier is hashed to 8-char hex regardless of which overload was used. attemptDiagnosticId / familyDiagnosticId delegate to createAttemptIdentity / createFamilyIdentity (single canonical encoder).

stage_2_classification.frozen_note: Classifier contract is locked. Future bugs are now in the runtime adapter (how AgentRuntime constructs ToolOutcomeClassificationInput), not in the classifier itself. C1.2 proves adapter truth; C1.1 stays frozen.

input_provenances: toolExecutionInvoked — whether tool.execute(...) was actually called
boundary_model.registry_miss_semantics: toolExists=false fires Priority 2 regardless of toolExecutionInvoked; production-truthful fixture is toolExists=false ∧ toolExecutionInvoked=false
boundary_model.runtime_skip_semantics: toolExecutionInvoked=false only reaches Priority 4 once toolExists=true has been proven at Priority 2

ENOENT handoff test now uses outcome.toolName and pins exact canonical control-family string
err.code policy documented honestly (any string code is structured; ENOENT/EACCES is a typed shortcut, not a conservative allowlist)
boundary model split: executionAttempted → toolExecutionInvoked; toolExists now drives Priority 2 alone
registry-miss fixture is now production-truthful: toolExists=false ∧ toolExecutionInvoked=false → tool_not_found (NOT runtime_skipped)
mutually exclusive invariant tests: unknown-tool / real-tool-skipped / real-tool-thrown
p1_corrections_applied: toolExecutionInvoked=false structurally emits control_plane / runtime_skipped (no longer a failure)
explicit user_rejected / host_policy_denied outrank runtime_skipped, isError=true regression pin added
low-level readErrorCode / classifyErrnoCode no longer re-exported from the classifier module (kept internal in failure-code.ts)

stage_2_classification.details: ToolRuntimeOutcome discriminator + failure-classifier.ts with provenance-first authority at AgentRuntime.executePreparedTool boundary. Pure, stateless, browser-safe. AgentRuntime integration NOT wired in this stage. Stage-1 57 tests still green. All P0/P1 corrections from C1.1 review applied; registry-miss and runtime-skip are now structurally distinct via the toolExists / toolExecutionInvoked boundary model.

stage_3_typed_exhaustion.details: RecoveryExhaustedError typed error with low-level AgentRunResult.error.kind discriminator

stage_4_runtime_integration.details: RuntimeRecovery bridge into AgentRuntime: pre-exec gate (use typed-identity overloads), post-exec classification (recordFailureIdentity), second-stage termination (catch in turn loop). Tool-result carries model-facing bounded_recovery_exhausted payload. Parallel-tool recovery semantics: TBD-proven in this stage before close.

stage_5_runtime_truth.details: recovery-state-changed event propagation; statusToLegacyFinishReason widening DEFERRED to COMPLETION-CHANGESET-UI-STATE-TRUTH01

privacy_discipline.boundary_mechanism: tracker-internal projection maps; legacy string overloads are now private with projection unconditionally hashing stored labels to 8-char hex on the public surface (no pass-through path)
privacy_discipline.collision_resistance: 32-bit collision resistance is for telemetry only; circuit decisions use unbounded canonical control identity

c1_2_entry_gate.purpose: C1.1 proves the classifier contract. C1.2 must prove the real AgentRuntime supplies truthful ToolOutcomeClassificationInput values. Three mechanical gates before any RecoveryTracker wiring.

gate_1_mechanical_invocation.name: toolExecutionInvoked must be a local boolean set by the actual call, not inferred from surrounding state
before: inferring toolExecutionInvoked from `result exists / skipReason absent / prepared.tool exists` is unsafe
after: try { toolExecutionInvoked = true; result = await prepared.tool.execute(...) }
the classifier receives the actual execution truth

gate_2_no_exit_code_fabrication.name: Do not invent exitCode from result text
gate_2_no_exit_code_fabrication.proven_by_c1_1: classifier supports `result: { isError: true, exitCode: 127 }` but C1.1 deliberately did NOT prove current production AgentToolResult exposes a native exitCode field
gate_2_no_exit_code_fabrication.if_structured_field: map it to result.exitCode directly; family = run_commands:tool_execution_error:<code>
gate_2_no_exit_code_fabrication.if_not_available: do NOT parse "exit code 127" from output text; classify conservatively as unknown / fallback / familyEligible=false
gate_2_no_exit_code_fabrication.rationale: same anti-false-merge policy we applied to schema errors; never infer typed structure from prose

gate_3_explicit_control_plane_provenance.name: Surpass the generic runtime_skipped fallback when the runtime actually knows more
gate_3_explicit_control_plane_provenance.fallback_only_for: known tool / not executed / no richer reason supplied
gate_3_explicit_control_plane_provenance.rationale: do NOT route everything through runtime_skipped merely because it would technically keep it outside recovery; the distinction will matter later for runtime telemetry and debugging

real_adapter_fixture_matrix.only_after_passing_all: C1.2 may connect outcomes to RecoveryTracker

do_not_map_retries_note: CLI --retries = broad consecutive mistake ceiling. maxRepairAttempts = narrow same-recovery-family convergence budget. Compose, do not alias.

checks.reason: C1.0 substrate tests at new location (39 tracker + 5 privacy + 13 fingerprint = 57 tests)

c1_0_post_correction_strict: Multi-family attribution test fixture verified: A and B vary only by stableCode, share toolName; sharedAttempt is constructed once and re-used across both recordFailureIdentity calls. Structural assertions (A.controlFamily !== B.controlFamily, sharedAttempt.controlKey === sharedAttemptAgain.controlKey) pin the fixture so a future regression that collapses the families or rebuilds the attempt identity cannot pass.

Public query API split documented: isFamilyBlocked() and activeFamily() are explicitly DEBUG / QUERY methods accepting/returning raw controlFamily because the runtime wiring layer needs them at the boundary; mutation/enforcement API is the typed-identity overloads only.
